messages:
maria: OK team, quick poll — who else thinks semver is just an optimistic suggestion? :joy:
jon: always. we ship v1.0.0, then v1.0.0-fix.1, then v1.0.0-fix.1.0.0. it's the upgrade treadmill. :turtle:
alex: pro tip: if you increment the minor version and nothing breaks, you just invented a feature 
mar ia: @alex thats how we added dark mode by renaming a CSS var :sweat_smile:
sam: i prefer YAML jokes: "Why did the YAML file go to therapy? It had too many unresolved anchors." :laughing:
jon: speaking of YAML, found this in a config today:
```
server:
  port: 8080
  routes:
    - path: /health
      method: GET
  enabled: yes
```
jon: "enabled: yes" vs "enabled: true" is the same until it decides to be a string and the parser ghosts you. :ghost:
ci-bot: Build 4821 failed on lint: YAML parsing error at line 5: duplicate key "routes". See logs: https://ci.example/4821 
alex: compiler meme: "I have a joke about undefined behaviour but you wouldn't catch it." :rofl:
maria: also saw a package published as `v0.0.0-2024-12-broken` and the entire dependency graph sighed. :weary:
sam: minor poll: if a PR message is just `fix` do you read the code? yes/no/only if CI fails
jon: only if CI fails. otherwise assume it's whitespace. :shrug:
alex: heres my contribution — a one-liner YAML patch:
```yaml
# accidentally fixes everything
---
+ apiVersion: v2
```
maria: :ok_hand: executable poetry.
jon: vote to add a "semver therapist" emoji to slack. :raised_hands:
ci-bot: Auto-reply: if you tag `@ci-bot help` I will attempt to fix your YAML but probably will just reopen the ticket. :robot_face:
sam: closing thought: if the compiler screams at 3am and no one is around to hear it, did the typechecker succeed? :thinking_face:
alex: classic. good night everyone. :crescent_moon:
